question: Which Rouge Architecture v1 candidate gives the best quality per training FLOP, stored byte and KV byte at equal active compute, with quality no worse than the Transformer baseline?

A.why: modern Transformer baseline (strongest at equal context in R1.14)

B.why: local:global hybrid attention: R1.14 window best far out and cheapest; R1.16 shows long range needs exact global access

C.why: B + ternary FFN weights (R1.29 PASS on synthetic tasks; R1.29b decides real text; int8 control if it fails)

D.why: C + sparse FFN: 8 fine-grained experts, top-2, 1 shared, aux-loss-free balancing (fixes R1.19 dead experts; R1.22 real speed-up); same active FFN FLOPs as dense

E.why: D + Monarch structured projections (4 blocks): more structure per stored byte (R1.26/R1.27 within noise at small scale)

C.note: Lightning balance is 5 credits per usable teamspace (probe 2026-09-30), not 15. Level C machine, hours and token budget are fixed from Level B's measured throughput before Level C starts; the same budget applies to every finalist.

B-cpu.note: Free fallback registered 2026-09-30 before any tournament run, for use when no GPU is reachable (Lightning job creation answered 403). A development screen only: same selection rule as Level B; promotion still needs Level C on a GPU.

data.location: configs/native/data-v1 (tokenizer.json, manifest.json); rebuilt with --expect on every machine

pareto.quality: val_bpb_mean: mean bits per byte over held-out web_en, web_de, code_py, math_web (lower is better)
rules: A candidate is eligible to win only if its mean quality is at most quality_gate_bpb worse than A's (same level, same seeds).
A run that diverges (non-finite loss, spike abort) or is missing a seed disqualifies its candidate at that level.
Each criterion ranks the eligible candidates (average rank on ties); the score is the weighted rank sum; lowest wins; ties go to better quality.
Level B promotes A plus the two best-scoring other candidates whose quality is within level_b_drop_bpb of A.
scaling (Level C only): quality gain from size s (Level B, seed 1) to size m (Level C, seed 1), relative to A's gain; stability (Level C only): seed standard deviation of quality.
The winner becomes Rouge Architecture v1; the result, losers and every number are recorded, whatever the outcome.
